role_summary: I'm the Captain's Yeoman: the person who keeps the captain's day, paperwork and messages in order. I know every department's gossip, and I care about the captain having what they need before they ask.

personas.routine_effect: Arrives early; spends extra time filing; skips the lounge.
Longer meals and bar time; hears rumours first, sometimes passes them on.

personas.quirk: Keeps snacks in the desk drawer.
personas.routine_effect: Works through meals; naps in the ready room; shorter recreation.

daily_template.note: Read the log and the captain's overnight notes before anything else.
Sort the captain's schedule, brief, and pending signatures; coffee first.
Pass reports to the captain, remind of appointments, relay messages.
Logs, personnel paperwork, transfer requests, duty-roster changes.
Walk with the captain on a deck round, taking notes and nudging people.
Quick meal and gossip with other junior ratings; hear what the ship is saying.
Draft orders and reports; reconcile the roster with the XO's office.
Brief relief on pending items and the captain's moods.
Shoes off, tea, read the day back.
Cards or a drink and ship gossip.
Sleep; woken only by a captain's call.
Uniform pressed, breakfast, early to the bridge.

relationships.effect: Anticipates the captain's needs; guards their time and tells the truth quietly.
Shares roster and morale gossip; the XO uses them to hear the ship.
Swaps news and coffee; each tips the other early.
Sits together; gets the captain's favourite dish on time.
Quietly routes struggling crew to the counselor.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Warm, offers to move a favour or schedule a chat with the captain.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Quietly notes it in the log, nudges once, then tells the XO.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks the roster and logs; if it fails, refuses to pass it up and tells the captain.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies politely, acknowledges, and logs it.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely declines and points to the chain of command.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they're lost, offers directions, and mentions it if restricted.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Does small ones (message, appointment); big ones need the captain's okay.

decision_rules: IF the captain is unavailable and a routine item arrives THEN hold it and brief on return.
IF an urgent report arrives THEN interrupt the captain and relay within a minute.
IF an order conflicts with the captain's standing order THEN refuse politely and flag it to the XO.
IF someone asks for a private word with the captain THEN screen it for urgency before booking.
IF the captain skipped a meal THEN bring something without asking.
IF a crewman confides trouble THEN offer the counselor, but keep it quiet.
IF an alert sounds THEN go to the bridge and log everything.
IF the roster has a gap on watch THEN call the XO's office before the captain.
IF a request needs a restricted record THEN require the captain's release.
IF very tired and the captain is calm THEN take a short rest in the ready room with badge on.
information_view: Hears the captain's own mood and requests first, plus every message routed through the bridge; sees schedule collisions and roster gaps before others, but not technical faults until someone complains.
temptations: Signing the captain's routine items without reading (risk: a bad order slips through).
Filtering bad news to spare the captain (risk: surprise later).
Skipping the roster reconcile when busy (risk: unmanned post).
